text: 【IMF总裁：各国央行需考量AI驱动增长或放缓】国际货币基金组织（IMF）总裁格奥尔基耶娃6日表示，各国央行在评估抗击通胀的举措时，需要将人工智能（AI）驱动的增长可能出现放缓纳入考量。格奥尔基耶娃当天在IMF位于美国首都华盛顿的总部表示，人们对于经济过度依赖AI投资热潮以及资产估值过高的担忧，正对全球市场产生影响。
text_en: [IMF chief: Central banks need to factor in AI-driven growth or slowdown] International Monetary Fund (IMF) Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva said on the 6th that central banks need to factor in a possible slowdown in AI-driven growth when assessing their measures to combat inflation. Speaking at the IMF headquarters in Washington, D.C., Georgieva said concerns about the economy's excessive reliance on the AI investment boom and overly high asset valuations are affecting global markets.
